title: Grease Monkeys
summary: Jackie's bike is coughing, so he asks you to hold the light in a Kabuki back-alley garage while you both listen for the fault.
description: Jackie's bike is coughing, so he asks V to come to his back-alley garage in Kabuki. V is to hold the light and help him listen for the fault.

start.bringUp: Jackie's bike is coughing, and he asks you to come to his garage in Kabuki, hold the light and help him listen. He says you will learn something.

g1.asks: What does it sound like to you? And don't say 'broken'.
g1.know: There are three possible causes: fuel, the plug or the air. Jackie has revved the bike twice, and you are close to the engine.
g1.secret: He talks to the bike when no one is listening.

stages.label: Jackie listens to the bike in the Kabuki garage
stages.objective: Listen for the fault in Jackie's bike in the Kabuki garage
stages.know: You are in a back-alley garage in Kabuki with Jackie and his bike on a lift. He has revved the engine, and you are listening for the fault.
stages.wants: V to stay close and help him find the fault.

stayed.memory: You held the light in Jackie's Kabuki garage for ten minutes and helped him listen to the bike.

left.memory: You and Jackie tried to fix a bike in a Kabuki garage, and you left before it was done.

unfinished.memory: You and Jackie were doing something light, and it ended there.

variations.know: A flat tire on the bike, and Jackie sure it is not the engine at all.
A chain problem, with grease on both of your hands.
A mystery rattle with no right answer, and Jackie laughing at every guess.
